functions.functionDefinition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION hr_public."current_user"()
 RETURNS hr_public.users
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT *
  FROM hr_public.users
  WHERE id = current_setting('jwt.claims.user_id', true)::uuid;
$function$

functions.returnType: TABLE(salary_amount numeric, salary_currency character varying, pay_frequency character varying, pay_type character varying, effective_date date)
functions.functionDefinition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION hr_public.get_current_compensation(emp_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(salary_amount numeric, salary_currency character varying, pay_frequency character varying, pay_type character varying, effective_date date)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Only HR managers and admins can access compensation data
    IF NOT (
        current_setting('jwt.claims.role', true) IN ('super_admin', 'admin', 'hr_manager')
        OR current_setting('jwt.claims.user_id', true)::uuid = emp_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient permissions to view compensation data';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        cr.salary_amount,
        cr.salary_currency,
        cr.pay_frequency,
        cr.pay_type,
        cr.effective_date
    FROM hr_private.compensation_records cr
    WHERE cr.employee_id = emp_id
        AND (cr.end_date IS NULL OR cr.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE)
    ORDER BY cr.effective_date DESC
    LIMIT 1;
END;
$function$
